user_query: I want to get the top and rising posts from the subreddit 'interesting' along with their number of comments and upvote ratio.

TaskList.description: Query the API to fetch the top posts from the subreddit 'interesting'.
Query the API to fetch the rising popular posts from the subreddit 'interesting'.
Extract and compile the number of comments and upvote ratio for each of the fetched posts.
Present the compiled data of top posts and rising posts with comments and upvote ratios.
